data.gender_notes: Akhal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Akhulla' which means 'to support' or 'to strengthen'. This name is associated with strength, power, and resilience. In Islamic history, it is said that the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) used the term 'Akhulla' to describe his companions, who were his pillars of support. The name Akhal carries the meaning “Strong, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Akhal usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
